titleZh: 宗教场所通用礼仪（外国游客版）
bodyZh: 进入寺院或祠庙时保持安静，按现场标识行走。未经明确允许，不要触摸造像、供器、壁画、经幡或古建筑构件；殿内是否允许拍照以现场标识为准，禁止使用闪光灯时应严格遵守。着装宜整洁、不过度暴露。游客可以参观，但不要模仿、打断或近距离拍摄正在进行的宗教活动。是否上香、捐赠完全自愿，不必因他人邀请而勉强参与。
bodyEn: Keep your voice low and follow on-site signs when entering a temple or shrine. Do not touch statues, ritual objects, murals, prayer flags or historic architectural elements unless permission is clearly given. Photography inside halls depends on local signage, and any no-flash rule should be followed strictly. Wear neat, reasonably modest clothing. Visitors are welcome to observe, but should not imitate, interrupt or closely film an ongoing religious activity. Incense offerings and donations are entirely optional; there is no need to participate because someone invites you to do so.
